position: This doctrine operationalises professional recommendations, not a universal formula. Automated checks may verify recorded decisions, references, consistency, and process evidence; they must not pretend to measure artistic greatness.
governing_principle: AI may propose possibilities, compare alternatives, diagnose weaknesses, and draft unlocked artefacts. It must not silently decide canon, theme, character motivation, factual claims, or structural changes.

strong_doctrine.principle: Define the novel situation, human problem, pressure source, and expected audience pleasure; packaging and opening must honour the same promise.
Keep chronological story, causal plot, and audience presentation distinct.
Major events require traceable causes, consequences, state changes, and deletion/counterfactual tests.
Characters, especially the protagonist and opposition, should make consequential decisions that alter later events.
strong_doctrine.enforcement: required character records plus advisory agency ratio

strong_doctrine.principle: Opposition must have an active goal, advantage, vulnerability, and costs for confrontation or avoidance.
Scenes and causal events must record what changes or what other story value earns their place.
strong_doctrine.enforcement: required state/value evidence; conventions remain advisory

strong_doctrine.principle: Track audience knowledge, questions, expectations, emotional orientation, and character knowledge around important reveals.
Every major setup has a planned payoff, explicit reinterpretation, or justified intentionally open status.
The climax resolves the central dramatic question through earlier causes and a consequential action or value choice.
strong_doctrine.enforcement: required ending design and human review

strong_doctrine.principle: Minecraft mechanics, geography, construction, resources, and world rules should influence goals, strategies, reversals, climax, or visual design rather than merely decorate the story.
strong_doctrine.enforcement: required story-engine fields and production review

strong_doctrine.principle: Revision uses a small core of always-required checks plus additional passes activated only when relevant to the script.
Canon, theme, motivation, factual claims, and structural changes remain versioned and human-approved; locked evidence cannot change silently.

flexible_conventions.use: Optional organising lens; require only a chosen framework and rationale.
Advisory recontextualisation device when supported by the material.
May be positive, negative, flat, collective, tragic, or deliberately minimal.
Useful diagnostic for most dramatic scenes; omissions create warnings, not gate failures.
Optional structural convention, never a mandatory timestamp.
Useful visual comparison when meaningful, not compulsory.
Production and pacing aid, not a fixed count or percentage.
Determined by story need and solo production capacity.

must_not_enforce: a twist at a predetermined timestamp
